t: No-Gooey Video: From Philosophical Rejection to Pythonic Victory
s: This article advocates a 'No-Gooey' Pythonic approach to automating video editing, likening AI-driven systems to intelligent 'horse and buggy' partners. It then explores a "triangulation of agency" for daily work, blending foundational system anchors (like NixOS), recent project context, and overarching vision to determine next steps, emphasizing the need for robust testing against AI-introduced entropy.
sub: AI as Intelligent Engines (Horse & Buggy Metaphor)
